newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel wanes with futures, quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel wanes with futures, quiet.

text.p: NWE jet fuel followed futures lower on Monday, but traders said premiums were fairly steady despite the added drag of little demand.
On the barge, premiums were assessed at Oct +$25/+$26 fob ARA, but no deals were heard.
On the cif cargo market, premiums were judged at around Oct +$35/+$36.
"It's pretty quiet but that's not unusual for a Monday. Now the gas oil has come off a bit, perhaps we'll see activity picking up as the week progresses," one trader said.
